def transform(g):
    sep=next(i for i,r in enumerate(g) if set(r)=={5})
    top=g[:sep]; bot=g[sep+1:]
    def objs(section):
        seen=set(); out=[]
        for i,r in enumerate(section):
            for j,v in enumerate(r):
                if v and (i,j) not in seen:
                    cells=[]; st=[(i,j)]; seen.add((i,j))
                    while st:
                        a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                        for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<len(section) and 0<=y<len(section[0]) and section[x][y]==v and (x,y) not in seen:
                                seen.add((x,y)); st.append((x,y))
                    out.append((v,cells))
        return out
    def norm(cells):
        a=min(c[0] for c in cells); b=min(c[1] for c in cells)
        return (frozenset((c[0]-a,c[1]-b) for c in cells), b)
    to=objs(top); bo=objs(bot)
    v0,bc=bo[0]
    bs,cj=norm(bc)
    mi=min(c[0] for c in bc); bh=max(c[0] for c in bc)-mi+1
    gap=len(bot)-(mi+bh)
    cands=[(v,c) for v,c in to if norm(c)[0]!=bs]
    v1,tc=max(cands,key=lambda x:max(c[1] for c in x[1]))
    ts,_=norm(tc)
    th=max(c[0] for c in ts)+1
    H=9
    out=[[0]*len(g[0]) for _ in range(H)]
    base=(H-1-gap)-bh+1  # top row of bottom shape in output
    for di,dj in ts: out[base-th+di][cj+dj]=v1
    for di,dj in bs: out[base+di][cj+dj]=v0
    return out
